description: This file defines the TouchDisplayView class, a custom Android View that visualizes multi-touch events and their history. It manages touch pointers, records their positions and pressures, and renders circles representing active touches with their historical data. It includes a nested static class TouchHistory for storing touch details and uses an object pool for reuse.

classes.name: TouchDisplayView
classes.description: A custom View class for displaying multi-touch input with visual representations of active pointers and their motion history.

classes.name: TouchHistory
classes.description: A static nested class that stores information about a single touch point, including its position, pressure, label, and movement history. It is pooled for efficient reuse.

methods.name: obtain
methods.description: Static method to acquire a new or recycled TouchHistory instance and initialize it with provided position and pressure.

methods.name: setTouch
methods.description: Sets the current position and pressure for this touch history.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Releases this TouchHistory object back into the pool for reuse.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a historical position point to the touch's history array.

methods.name: initialisePaint
methods.description: Initializes paint objects and dimensions based on device density for drawing.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events, updating the touch pointers and their data, and invalidates the view for redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws active touches and their histories on the canvas, adjusting background color based on touch activity.

methods.name: drawCircle
methods.description: Draws a circle at the touch point with size based on pressure, including historical points and label.
